name: Caldo de mancarra
subtitle: Caldo de mancarra is a stew of fish, chicken or meat based on peanut paste diluted with water; mancarra is the Guinean name for the peanut.

facts.label: Name
facts.value: Mancarra is the Guinean name for the peanut.

facts.label: Place in the cuisine
facts.value: One of the most common and typical dishes of Guinea-Bissau, as the peanut is one of the most widely found foods in the country.

facts.label: What it is
facts.value: A stew of fish, chicken or meat based on peanut paste diluted with water, described by a man from near Bissau as the best-known dish.

facts.label: Variation
facts.value: Like caldo de chabéu, it can be made with different main ingredients (mafés), without a single official version.

facts.label: Related dish
facts.value: Very similar to the Senegalese peanut stew mafé.

parts.text: Caldo de mancarra is a stew of fish, chicken or meat based on peanut paste diluted with water; mancarra is the Guinean name for the peanut. It is described as one of the most common and typical dishes of Guinea-Bissau, where the peanut is one of the most widely found foods.
It is served with white rice.
